prompt:
Research the officially documented free-tier rate limits of the Google Gemini API (requests per minute and per day) for its current models. Cite Google's documentation and quote the limits.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Below are the documented free-tier rate limits I could verify from Google’s current Gemini API documentation. Note that the official overview page specifies the *dimensions* of rate limits (RPM, TPM, RPD) but refers users to AI Studio for model-specific numbers; therefore, exact RPM/RPD values for current specific models are not published in a static table on that page.

SOURCE: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/rate-limits | QUOTE: "Rate limits are usually measured across three dimensions: Requests per minute (RPM), Tokens per minute (input) (TPM), Requests per day (RPD)" | CLAIM: The Gemini API free tier enforces limits on requests per minute and requests per day (RPD), which reset at midnight Pacific time.
SOURCE: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/rate-limits | QUOTE: "Rate limits are more restricted for experimental and preview models." | CLAIM: Experimental and preview models have lower rate limits than stable models on the free tier.
SOURCE: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/rate-limits | QUOTE: "Specified rate limits are not guaranteed and actual capacity may vary." | CLAIM: Google does not guarantee that the published rate limits will always be available at maximum capacity.
SOURCE: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/rate-limits | QUOTE: "Rate limits are tied to the project's usage tier." | CLAIM: Rate limits vary by usage tier (Free, Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3), with the Free tier having the most restrictive limits.
SOURCE: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/billing | QUOTE: "New accounts begin on the Free Tier, which allows access to certain models in the Gemini API and AI Studio, up to the models' free tier rate limits." | CLAIM: The Free Tier provides access to certain models with specific rate limits that are distinct from paid tiers.

NO_SOURCE_FOUND: Exact numerical requests per minute (RPM) and requests per day (RPD) values for current specific Gemini models (e.g., Gemini 3.8 Flash, Gemini 3.7 Flash) on the free tier, as the official rate limits documentation refers users to Google AI Studio to view their active limits rather than publishing a static table of model-specific free-tier quotas.
